title: A pipeline stage
hints: A stage takes a receive-only input channel and returns a receive-only output channel. Inside, it creates a bidirectional channel, sends on it from a goroutine, and returns it; the return type narrows it to <-chan int.
Square must not block: start a goroutine that loops forever: v := <-in; out <- v * v.
func Square(in <-chan int) <-chan int { out := make(chan int); go func() { for { v := <-in; out <- v * v } }(); return out }
